name: subagent-spend
description: Per-subagent tokens, rate-limit windows, context fill, cost, steps, tool calls and tool errors of a Claude Code session, in a notice under the prompt, local files and panes (the usage pane not yet seen on a screen).

dir.title: Rows folder
dir.description: Folder for the per-session rows file. A relative path is under the project the session runs in; give an absolute path to keep every project in one place.

usageFile.title: Usage file and pane
usageFile.description: Show the rate-limit windows, context fill and cost in the status line and a Usage pane, and write them to latest.json. Off: none of that.

usageFileDir.title: Usage file folder
usageFileDir.description: Folder for latest.json. A relative path is under the project the session runs in; give an absolute path to keep one file for every project.

turnTally.title: Turn counts
turnTally.description: Count the main conversation's steps, tool calls and tool errors in the status line and a file for each day. Off: none of that.

turnTallyDir.title: Turn counts folder
turnTallyDir.description: Folder for the day's counts file. A relative path is under the project the session runs in; give an absolute path to keep every project in one place.
